scope: Weld command sampling correction; offline software validation only.
root_cause: The shaper added instantaneous reference velocity to a position chase although the nominal position was already sampled at the end of the current interval. Irregular sampling inflated commanded travel even with additive A1 correction disabled.
changes: Use exact successive nominal position increments for welding, with pursuit applied to residual correction.
Limit changes of interval-average command velocity over interval-midpoint spacing on irregular weld ticks.
Retain preparation pursuit and braking, PID gains, fixed endpoint holds, continuous repeat semantics, motor modes and all existing ceilings and trips.
Record shaping_policy and acceleration_interval_s in trace entries; keep ILC deferred under ILC-01.

replay.condition: Additive corrections disabled, derivative limits inactive on the recorded checked path.

tests.coverage: Recorded cadence, fixed 5-100 ms and alternating cadence, periodic seams, active PID and saturation, native fake-CAN execution, preparation/retreat, motion guards, fixed holds, journal analysis and offscreen GUI.

next_operator_trial: Normally restart the panel and repeat the same arm-only --weld-a1-shaper-only launch. Verify tracker.version=6 and shaping_policy=sampled_reference_increment. No firmware change is required.
remaining_limits: No new physical response, tip position/orientation or load qualification is claimed.
Existing enabled-axis additive PID, including A6 in the matched trial, remains active and requires separate tuning.
The fitted 144 ms physical tracking lag is not identified as a fixed transport delay or eliminated by this offline test.
ILC is later future work; no learning is implemented.
